scope: cross-platform numerical metric and artifact stability
metric_definition_policy: registry version and changelog marker required for every definition change
migration_policy: additive v0-to-v1 only; unknown versions fail closed
limitations: The PR matrix is deterministic and tiny; scheduled jobs must supply real licensed model and reference-hardware evidence.
Floating-point equivalence is not asserted across unlike hardware; semantic drift thresholds are explicit per metric.
Artifact identity is exact only when both sides provide a digest and size.
